visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a dark-colored smartphone held by a hand over a neutral-toned wooden table. The screen displays a software update interface with Traditional Chinese text and a progress bar, surrounded by soft indoor lighting that highlights the phone's metallic edges and glass surface. (2) The thumb of the hand interacts with a text document on the screen, selecting a paragraph. A menu titled 'Writing Tools' appears, showcasing various UI icons for AI-driven text refinement, such as 'Professional' and 'Friendly,' with subtle animated transitions as choices are highlighted. (3) The scene shifts to a personal profile interface within a mobile application. The hand scrolls through a block of text, and the AI interface generates a summary with bullet points at the bottom of the screen, utilizing clean white backgrounds and modern sans-serif typography. (4) A digital flyer for an animation exhibition is displayed. The user long-presses on the date and location details, triggering an overlay menu that suggests adding the information to the calendar, with the UI elements appearing responsive and high-contrast against the blue flyer background. (5) The view transitions to a laptop screen displaying an email client interface. A cursor moves across the screen to click on a 'Refine' button, which opens a modal window containing a drafted response, demonstrating the software's ability to generate structured text within a desktop environment. (6) Back on the smartphone, the iMessage keyboard is active. The user accesses the 'Genmoji' tool, typing text into a purple-glowing search bar that causes a cake emoji to transform into a chocolate version, with smooth graphical scaling and rendering effects visible on the display. (7) An image of a brown and white dog on a green lawn is shown in the Photos app. The user circles a figure in the background using a brush tool, and the 'Clean Up' feature removes the person, seamlessly filling the area with grass and foliage textures. (8) The video returns to the software update screen, showing the installation has successfully finished, with the device reflecting the warm ambient light of the room.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male narrator begins speaking in Traditional Chinese with a bright, welcoming tone. He is accompanied by an upbeat electronic-pop BGM with a steady 124 BPM rhythm and prominent synth bass. A sharp digital 'tick' SFX occurs as the first UI interaction is heard. (2) As the narrator describes the AI writing tools, a soft synthesized 'whoosh' SFX signals the text generation. The vocal delivery is fast and clear, with the narrator's pitch rising in excitement. The BGM maintains a consistent rhythmic drive with light percussive elements. (3) A clear digital 'ding' SFX marks the completion of the text summary feature. The narrator's voice exhibits high arousal, emphasizing the word '重點化' (highlighting key points). The background audio floor remains extremely quiet and professional, with no ambient interference. (4) A bubble-like 'pop' SFX is heard as the calendar integration is activated. The narrator continues with a high-valence delivery, his speech matching the rhythmic pace of the background music. There is a balanced overlap between the primary speech and the BGM. (5) During the email refinement demonstration, a rhythmic digital 'ping' SFX accompanies the appearance of the text modal. The music swells slightly in volume but remains well below the vocal track, maintaining a high signal-to-noise ratio for the commentary. (6) A shimmering, magical synthesizer SFX plays as the 'Genmoji' is created on screen. The narrator's tone becomes more playful and comedic, using a higher pitch to express delight at the 'chocolate cake' result. The audio editing is tight and synced. (7) Multiple soft 'swish' and 'shimmer' SFX are triggered in rapid succession as the background removal tool is demonstrated. The narrator's tone reflects awe, using dynamic intonation to emphasize the effectiveness of the AI, followed by a final concluding sentence and BGM fade.
